title: Magdeburg PTR-MS psychiatric breath m/z → atlas VOC map
honesty: This maps published Magdeburg PTR-MS mass channels to atlas VOC identities when authors named them. Unnamed m/z channels are listed but not forced into measured_log2fc. Figshare 19181742 is a DOCX supplement, not a patient intensity matrix.

cohorts.label: Jiang/Frodl 2023 schizophrenia vs MDD vs controls

cohorts.direction_summary: SCFA and amine alterations; butyric means published

mz_map.notes: Common PTR-MS methanol channel; reduced in Magdeburg schizophrenia stability cohort
Jiang 2022 reduced mass among schizophrenia signatures
JPN 2023 explicitly identifies m/z 60 as trimethylamine
JPN 2023 / Luib identify m/z 69 as isoprene
Gbaoui identifies n-butanamine at m/z 74; Magdeburg SCZ series uses m/z 74 as discriminator.
Reduced in MDD/SCZ; not uniquely mapped to a single atlas VOC
Luib associates m/z 89 with butanoic/butyric acid
JPN 2023 identifies m/z 90 as butyric acid and esters
